osmTags.inscription: Spoleto hab' ich bestiegen und war auf der Wasserleitung, die zugleich Brücke von einem Berg zu einem andern ist. Die zehen Bogen, welche über das Tal reichen, stehen von Backsteinen [...]. Goethe (1749-1832) Italienische Reise / Viaggio in Italia

Dalle mura di questa Rocca il 13/10 e il 26/11 del 1943 forzando la dura custodia fascista evasero 94 detenuti politici italiani e sloveni per raggiungere sulle nostre montagne i primi nuclei partigiani e riaffermare il diritto dei popoli alla libertà
Qui sono custodite le ceneri di Thomas Shippers 1930 1977

elements.name: Chiesa dei Santi Simone e Giuda

eras.label: Mapped site · auto T1
eras.summary: Mapped outline, terrain and present-day surroundings from open data. No historic reconstruction.
eras.basis: Everything drawn is traced from OpenStreetMap ways (ODbL) and the Terrarium elevation tiles. Each element names its OSM way.
eras.conjecture: Walls and buildings without a sourced height are drawn as kerb-high plan lines, never as masses. Closed walls have no gates: none are mapped. The DEM is ~30 m source resolution: it cannot show terraces, ditches or scarps. Nothing historic is depicted.
